title: The running session
prompt: This program asks the builder for a session and then looks inside it. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
program:
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

s = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()
print(s is spark)
print(s.sparkContext.master)
print(s.conf.get("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions"))
hints: A session is already running, so think about what `getOrCreate()` does when one exists.
`master` says where Spark runs and with how many cores.
Settings come back as text, and this environment changed the shuffle setting from Spark's usual 200.
